latest.title: Oversubscribed Retail Offer
latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 6425T
Futura Medical PLC
07 September 2026
THIS ANNOUNCEMENT AND THE INFORMATION CONTAINED HEREIN IS RESTRICTED AND IS NOT FOR RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION, IN WHOLE OR IN PART, DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, IN, INTO OR FROM THE UNITED STATES, CANADA, AUSTRALIA, THE REPUBLIC OF SOUTH AFRICA, OR JAPAN, OR ANY OTHER JURISDICTION IN WHICH SUCH RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION WOULD BE UNLAWFUL. PLEASE SEE THE IMPORTANT NOTICES AT THE END OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT.
THIS ANNOUNCEMENT CONTAINS INSIDE INFORMATION FOR THE PURPOSES OF REGULATION (EU) 596/2014 AS IT FORMS PART OF DOMESTIC LAW IN THE UNITED KINGDOM BY VIRTUE OF THE EU (WITHDRAWAL) ACT 2018 ("UK MAR").
Unless otherwise defined, definitions contained in this announcement have the same meanings as set out in the Company's announcements dated 3 September 2026.
7 September 2026
Futura Medical plc
("Futura" or the "Company")
Oversubscribed Retail Offer
Futura Medical plc (AIM: FUM), the consumer healthcare group behind Eroxon®, that specialises in the development and global commercialisation of innovative and clinically proven sexual health products, announces that the Retail Offer on the BookBuild platform, which closed at 4:30 p.m. on Friday, 4 September 2026, was significantly oversubscribed.
Consequently, the Company, after consultation with its advisers, has upscaled the Retail Offer from the intended £150,000 and instead conditionally raised £200,000, before expenses, through the issue of 100,000,000 new Ordinary Shares of 0.2p each (the "
Retail Offer Shares
"). with allocations scaled back proportionately, taking into account both applicants' existing shareholdings and the number of Retail Offer Shares applied for. As a result, the Company has conditionally raised a total of approximately £1.8 million, before expenses, pursuant to the Firm Placing, Conditional Placing, Conditional Subscription and Retail Offer.
General Meeting, Admission and Total Voting Rights
As referenced in the announcement of 3 September 2026 and the Circular dated 4 September 2026, admission of the Retail Offer shares to trading on AIM is conditional upon the passing of the Equity Funding Resolutions to be tabled at a general meeting of the Company, scheduled for 10:00 a.m. on 23 September 2026. Immediately following admission of the Firm Placing Shares to trading on AIM (the "
Initial Admission
"), the Company will have 639,460,530 ordinary shares of £0.002 each in issue. An announcement confirming total voting rights following issue of the Conditional Placing Shares, Conditional Subscription Shares and the Retail Offer Shares (the "
Subsequent Admission
"), will be released by the Company in due course. It is expected that Initial Admission will become effective and dealings in the Firm Placing Shares will commence on AIM at 8.00 a.m. on 9 September 2026 and that Subsequent Admission will become effective and dealings commence on AIM at 8.00 a.m. on 25 September 2026.

Notes to Editors:
Futura Medical plc (AIM: FUM) is the developer of innovative, consumer-focused, sexual health products, including lead product Eroxon® and development projects WSD4000 and Eroxon® Intense. Our core strength lies in our research, development, regulatory and business development expertise in developing innovative, clinically proven, insight-led and effective products to support our customers in the growing sexual health market.
Sexual health issues are prevalent globally in both men and women. Erectile Dysfunction ("
ED
") impacts 1 in 5 men globally across all adult age brackets, with approximately half of all men over 40 experiencing ED and 25% of all new diagnoses being in men under 40. 60% of women experience at least one symptom of impaired sexual response or function in a twelve-month period, with only one in four women seeking professional help and remaining chronically underserved.
Eroxon®, Futura's clinically proven lead product, has been developed for the treatment of ED. The highly differentiated product, which is the only topical gel treatment for ED available over the counter and helps men get an erection fast, addresses significant unmet needs in the ED market. Multiple license or distribution partnerships are in place for Eroxon®, across major consumer markets.
WSD4000 is a project name for Futura's development female sexual health portfolio, starting with the creation of a range of topical gels under Futura's unique platform technology, specifically designed to treat symptoms of sexual dysfunction in women. There is currently no known regulatory approved OTC treatment available for impaired sexual response and function in women. WSD4000 has the potential to be an effective, breakthrough treatment for the common symptoms associated with impaired sexual response and function, such as lack of desire, arousal, lubrication, ability to orgasm and overall sexual satisfaction.

company_30s.what_they_do: Futura Medical plc designs and sells compact imaging devices that use advanced algorithms to detect early‑stage diseases such as breast cancer. The core product is a low‑cost, handheld scanner that can be used in clinics that lack expensive imaging infrastructure.
company_30s.why_they_matter: The global market for affordable diagnostics is worth billions, especially in emerging economies. Futura’s proprietary software lets a single device produce high‑resolution images, giving it a competitive edge over larger, cost‑intensive systems. If the company can bring its product to market, it could capture a sizable share of the underserved diagnostic sector.
company_30s.current_state: The firm is in a growth‑phase funding cycle. It recently completed a highly oversubscribed retail offer, diluting shareholders but injecting fresh capital. It is also expanding into the EU and U.S. markets, with clinical data from recent studies supporting its next‑generation device. The share price sits very low, but the company still holds enough cash to sustain operations for the next 12–18 months.

rns_narrative: The company is juggling a capital‑raising effort that just closed a retail offer, while simultaneously moving through a formal offer process that will add new shares to the market. In parallel, it is pushing product milestones: a European market launch clearance, positive clinical data on its WSD4000 platform, and a new U.S. commercial partnership.

These events form three themes: (1) Capital structure changes – new shares, dilution, and a formal offer; (2) Product development – regulatory approvals and clinical validation; (3) Governance updates – AGM corrections, disclosure tables, and meeting notices.

The narrative suggests the company is trying to stabilize its finances while positioning its flagship product for wider adoption. The recent oversubscription indicates some investor interest, and the U.S. partnership could unlock a large revenue stream if the device clears regulatory hurdles.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Cautiously hopeful – investors are watching for funding and product milestones but wary of dilution.
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: Bullish voices point to the oversubscribed retail offer, the new U.S. partner, and the positive clinical data as proof that the company is moving forward.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Bearish chatter focuses on the 67‑plus percent dilution, the fact that the company is still raising money, and the risk that regulatory approvals might stall or fail.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: Initially neutral, sentiment has trended slightly bullish as the retail offer closed and the U.S. partnership was announced, but remains cautious because of dilution concerns.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends for FUM.L is flat – no recent search spikes, which means the market is largely unaware of upcoming catalysts.

near_term_catalysts: The formal offer that closed on Oct 2 will release a new tranche of shares; a price spike could follow if the market interprets the offer as a sign of confidence.
Regulatory clearance for the WSD4000 device in the EU (or a similar approval in the U.S.) would remove a major blocker to revenue growth.
A press release confirming a new U.S. commercial partnership or a signed order would signal market traction.
expect_next.watch_for: Look for a volume surge that exceeds the 3‑month average by 2‑3×, a price break above the 0.15p support level, and an official announcement of regulatory approval or a signed U.S. order.
expect_next.timing_regime: The company is still in the early recovery stage of a deep crash. The APEX score of 11/21 shows moderate compression, suggesting that a bounce is possible but will likely require a clear catalyst to move the market.

buy_vs_sell.bull_case: The stock has crashed more than 80 % from its peak, creating a steep mean‑reversion potential. If the price recovers to 0.20p (halfway to the 0.40p peak), the upside is roughly 300 %. The recent retail offer and U.S. partnership give the company a realistic path to revenue, and the APEX compression indicates the market is primed for a rebound.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: Dilution has already cut shareholder value, and the company still needs regulatory approvals for its key product. If the device fails to clear the U.S. or EU markets, the company could run out of cash before it can generate sales, leading to a deeper decline or even delisting.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential loss is limited to the current price (roughly 0.05p). Potential gain is up to 0.20p, giving a risk‑to‑reward ratio of about 1 : 4. The asymmetry is clear: a small loss could be offset by a large upside if the catalysts play out.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter at the next volume spike above 0.07p, size the position so that the stop‑loss is 20 % below entry (≈0.06p). Target 0.18p, and trail the stop to lock in gains once the price moves past 0.15p.
playbook.if_watching: Hold cash until the formal offer closes and the company announces either regulatory clearance or a signed U.S. order. Trigger a buy if the price rises above 0.12p on 5‑day average volume.
playbook.if_passing: If the company announces a failure to secure EU or U.S. approvals, or if it files for insolvency, exit immediately. No other terminal risks are present at this stage.

ai_insights.bottom_line: FUM.L sits at the bottom of a deep crash but is poised for a high‑reward rebound once the formal offer closes and regulatory milestones are met; the upside outweighs the limited downside.
